notes: annual_reports/ONEBANKPLC contains 15 PDFs-turned-text (FY2011-FY2025), pre-extracted with pdftotext -layout by a prior session before this bank was assigned; no downloading was needed for this task. Reporting basis confirmed Solo (Standalone) for all 15 years: each year's own report's 'Five Years' Financial Highlights' / 'Financial Highlights on the Overall Activities of the Bank' Total Assets figure was checked directly against that same report's own labelled 'Balance Sheet' (Solo) vs 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' - the Solo figure matches in every year checked (2012, 2016, 2020, 2023, 2025 spot-checked exactly; Consolidated is consistently higher, by roughly 0.04%-1.3% on total assets, reflecting two majority/wholly-owned subsidiaries - ONE Securities Limited and ONE Investments Limited - consolidated from around FY2012-2013 onward). Every one of the 15 reports' own multi-year summary table(s) was parsed and cross-checked against the same figures as republished in adjacent reports (per project methodology); this surfaced one large, IAS-8-disclosed restatement (FY2022/FY2023 balance sheet and FY2023 P&L, see the 2023_Q4 and 2022_Q4 entries below), several smaller reclassifications (FY2020 equity, FY2025 Start-up Fund), one retroactively-disclosed provision shortfall (FY2021), and one apparent isolated compilation error in the FY2024/FY2025 reports' five-year table (Net Profit After Taxation column for FY2020-2022). All of these are recorded below and in each affected year's period_note; contemporaneous (each year's own report) figures are used throughout the dataset per project policy, never the later restated/divergent figure, except where noted. UPDATE (2026-08-27): Q1/Q2/Q3 unaudited interim financial statements for 2012-2025 (42 quarters) were subsequently found and extracted from onebank.com.bd/financial-statement/ (a page distinct from the annual-report archive), Solo basis throughout, confirming reporting-basis continuity with the Q4/annual series; see the '<year> Q1/Q2/Q3 (unaudited interim)' entries below and quarterly/<year>_Q{1,2,3}.json. 2011 has no interim filings on the bank's own site (genuine absence). The single highest-value finding from this pass: ONE Bank's FY2024 and FY2025 deferred-tax-driven profit rescues are NOT visible in the unaudited interim filings at all -- both years' 9-month cumulative results were a healthy, tax-unremarkable profit, and the entire pre-tax collapse plus the entire deferred-tax credit that rescued reported PAT are concentrated in Q4 alone (the audited period) -- see insights.json.

sources.note: Year-end position from ONE Bank Limited's FY2020 Annual Report, Solo basis. MAJOR FINDING: Total Shareholders' Equity reported here as 16,946.727m (Revaluation Reserve for Securities component: 11.908m); the FY2021 report's comparative balance sheet for 31.12.2020 instead shows Total Shareholders' Equity of 17,413.005m (Revaluation Reserve: 478.186m), with the entire +466.278m difference exactly offset by an equal decrease in Other Liabilities (28,862.725m to 28,396.447m) - i.e. a pure reclassification of part of a securities revaluation surplus out of 'Other Liabilities' into the equity-side 'Revaluation Reserve' line, with Total Assets and reported profit unaffected. Contemporaneous (16,946.727m) figure is retained per 'prefer contemporaneous'; both figures independently satisfy the balance-sheet identity. SECOND FINDING: Capital Surplus/(deficit) reported here as 1,030.704m (implying required capital = 24,919.851m, i.e. ~12.5% of this report's own RWA of 199,358.810m); the FY2021 report's comparative for FY2020 instead shows 6,014.674m (implying ~10.0% of the same RWA figure) - the RWA and Tier1/Tier2/Total Capital figures themselves are identical between the two reports, only the required-capital percentage embedded in the disclosed surplus changed. This is consistent with Bangladesh Bank's Capital Conservation Buffer having reached full phase-in (2.5%, i.e. 12.5% total) by FY2019/FY2020 before an apparent COVID-era relaxation back toward a 10% effective requirement reflected in later reports' comparatives - see sources.json. Contemporaneous 1,030.704m figure is retained. Provision surplus/(deficit) reported as nil ('-') in both this report and the FY2021 report's own comparative for FY2020 - see FY2021 note for the subsequent retroactive restatement of this specific figure starting with the FY2022 report.

sources.source_document: onebankplc-annual-report-2023.txt ("Five Years' Financial Highlights" and "Financial Highlights on the Overall Activities of the Bank", both Solo basis; own Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account used for cross-validation)
sources.note: Year-end position from ONE Bank PLC's FY2023 Annual Report, Solo basis (the company was renamed from 'ONE Bank Limited' to 'ONE Bank PLC' this year following the Companies Act's PLC designation change). MAJOR RESTATEMENT: the FY2024 Annual Report presents a three-column Balance Sheet/P&L (31.12.2024, 31.12.2023 Restated, 01.01.2023 Restated) under IAS 8, explicitly labelling Other Assets, Other Liabilities, Surplus in P&L Account, Deferred Tax and EPS as '(Prior year's balance restated)'. FY2023 Total Assets: originally reported 317,770.682m -> restated 321,580.396m (+3,809.714m, +1.20%). FY2023 Total Shareholders' Equity: originally reported 19,242.966m -> restated 22,716.633m (+3,473.667m, +18.05%), again overwhelmingly a retained-earnings ('Surplus in P&L Account': 1,260.760m -> 4,734.427m) effect rather than a profit restatement. FY2023 Net Profit After Tax: originally reported 1,357.381m -> restated (in the FY2024 report's own comparative P&L Account) 1,151.631m (-205.750m, -15.16%) - this IS a formal restatement of the income statement itself (unlike FY2022, which had its balance sheet but not its P&L restated). FY2023 Total Regulatory Capital was correspondingly revised from 30,581.721m (original, internally consistent with this report's own Tier1 22,880.472m + Tier2 7,701.248m) to 30,307.962m per the FY2024 report's tables (a ~274m reduction consistent with the retained-earnings/Tier-1 impact of the profit restatement). Both the original and restated balance sheets independently satisfy the accounting identity (assets=liabilities+equity) exactly, so the original figures are not arithmetically impossible; contemporaneous (original) figures are retained throughout this dataset per 'prefer contemporaneous'. This restatement pattern recurs again in the FY2025 report (which re-restates the FY2023/FY2024 boundary using yet other 'Other Assets' figures), indicating an ongoing/recurring restatement practice at this bank rather than a single one-off correction - flagged as a data-quality caveat in insights.json.

Profit before tax was only 608.870m, but a large net deferred-tax INCOME of 670.915m (current tax expense 670.105m offset by a deferred-tax credit of 1,341.019m, explicitly labelled 'Prior year's balance restated') flipped this to a Net Profit After Tax of 1,279.785m - i.e. reported profit is dominated by a one-off deferred-tax recognition, not operating performance (Total Provision for loans/advances rose to 7,299.516m from 2,049.323m the prior year). sources.source_document: onebankplc-annual-report-2025.txt ("Five Years' Financial Highlights" and "Financial Highlights on the Overall Activities of the Bank", both Solo basis; own Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account used for cross-validation)
sources.note: Year-end position from ONE Bank PLC's FY2025 Annual Report, Solo basis. Profit before tax was NEGATIVE (loss of 1,827.040m, driven by Total Provision of 6,465.126m against Total Operating Income of only 11,749.977m - Net Interest Income collapsed to 2,487.582m from 6,081.025m the prior year on rising cost of funds), but a large net deferred-tax income of 2,043.847m (current tax expense 556.344m offset by a deferred-tax credit of 2,600.190m) flipped this to a small positive Net Profit After Tax of 216.806m - the third consecutive year (2023, 2024, 2025 all show sharply declining or negative pre-tax profit rescued by deferred-tax credits, see insights.json) that reported PAT is dominated by tax accounting rather than operating performance. Same 'Five Years' Financial Highlights' PAT-anomaly caveat as FY2024 applies to this report's comparative columns for FY2020-2022 (this report simply reproduces the FY2024 report's exhibit for those columns unchanged). Balance-sheet finding: a new equity line 'Start-up Equity Investment Fund' (98.236m for FY2025, 96.068m for the FY2024 comparative) appears for the first time in this report; FY2024's OWN report had booked this fund within provisions/Other Liabilities (note 12.10 'Provision for Start up Fund'), not as equity - this exactly explains the entire difference between FY2024's own reported Total Shareholders' Equity (23,454.178m) and this report's restated FY2024 comparative (23,550.247m = 23,454.178m + 96.068m). A minor, fully-traced reclassification, not a profit or asset-quality restatement.
